limitations: No signer IDs supplied: official split is clip based; unseen-signer performance is unmeasured.
Only about four official test clips per class; estimates have wide uncertainty.
Synthetic static controls do not replace live camera testing.

synthetic_static_controls.scope: 300 repeated real training frames, 3 canonical open palms, 3 canonical fists, body-only no-hands and all-zero sequences; excludes jitter/moving out-of-dataset hard negatives.

episode_rule: Finish after >300ms without usable hands/body; trim first/last usable frame; no prefix acceptance
validation_note: Episode protocol developed after initial stream test inspection; these are exploratory dataset release gates, not an untouched confirmatory benchmark.
